name: Pharaoh
summary: The king of Egypt whom Moses and Aaron told to let Israel go. He hardened his heart through plague after plague, until the LORD struck Egypt's firstborn and then threw his army into the sea.

key_moments.title: Refuses to Let Israel Go
key_moments.description: Moses and Aaron told Pharaoh that the LORD said to let His people go. Pharaoh said he did not know the LORD, and made their work harder by no longer giving them straw for bricks.

key_moments.title: Begging for Relief
key_moments.description: When frogs covered the land, Pharaoh asked Moses to pray to the LORD to take them away, and promised to let the people go. But once the frogs died, Pharaoh hardened his heart.

key_moments.title: Admits He Has Sinned
key_moments.description: After the LORD sent thunder and hail, Pharaoh admitted he had sinned and that the LORD is righteous. Yet when the hail stopped, he sinned again and hardened his heart.

key_moments.title: Loses His Firstborn and Lets Israel Go
key_moments.description: At midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn in Egypt, even Pharaoh's firstborn. That night Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron and told them to take the people and go.

key_moments.title: Chases Israel into the Sea
key_moments.description: Pharaoh changed his mind and chased Israel with his chariots. The LORD opened the sea for Israel, then the waters came back and covered all of Pharaoh's army.
